title: Gaussian quantile recovery
statement: For every real number $\alpha$ with $0<\alpha<1$, the standard Gaussian distribution function evaluated at its lower $\alpha$-quantile equals $\alpha$: $\Phi(Q(\alpha))=\alpha$.
replaced: Let $\Phi(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}\,dx$, and let $Q(\alpha)$ be $\inf\{t\in\mathbb R:\alpha\le\Phi(t)\}$ for $0<\alpha<1$ and $0$ otherwise. For every $\alpha\in\mathbb R$ with $0<\alpha<1$, one has $\Phi(Q(\alpha))=\alpha$.
